title: Great tour!
text: Absolutely recommend this tour! Rosa was our guide and she was wonderful, highly knowledgeable of the city and Alcazar. Tour was perfect amount of time and you are able to continuing exploring the gardens and even walk through the palace again on your own once it ends.
author: Clare_T

title: Visually Stunning and Historically Informative
text: Cannot say enough about the alcazar and cathedral tour.  These two places are a must see in Sevilla.  We booked our through our hotel w early tickets and in English.  I hate that I don’t call the guide’s name but she was wonderful.  The tour was through Poncho Tours and their office is a little hard to locate so start a little early.
author: ctsmith25

title: Our guide made our tour exceptional
text:
Our guide, Rosa, absolutely made this visit something exceptional. Her English was the best of any guide we’ve had. Her passion was articulated in her dialogue about the palace. Yes, dialogue, because she welcomed our questions and discussed with us our curiosities and observations. This felt like an interactive tour vs just having a person tell you about a place. 

If you’re lucky enough to get her, you’ll have an incredible tour and come on people, tip an exceptional guide!  Appreciating the great ones like Rosa might help preserve their enthusiasm for the future.
author: Elizabeth_R

title: Our tour guide, Rosa,...
text: Our tour guide, Rosa, made all the difference. She was knowledgeable,  passionate and was able to 'read' the group. We really enjoyed the experience. Thank you, Rosa.
author: Anita_R

title: Good tour
text: We took the combined tour with the Alcazar and the Cathedral.  Our guide Rosa was enthusiastic and knowledgeable.  She helped us get a better understanding of the local history and was able to answer our questions.  She also pointed out to us good vantages points for photographs.
author: 574RichardD

title: Palace in the Sun
text: Our guide was excellent.  We loved the story.  So many details we would have missed without her. Of course the beauty of the Palace is breathtaking.
author: Heather_c

title: Very enjoyable tour, our...
text: Very enjoyable tour, our guide Rosanne looked after her group very well. Great knowledge delivered in a friendly, accessible way made this a fab experience.  Many thanks!
author: Alicean_H

title: Good tour guide
text: Our tour guide is very knowledgeable and with fluent English.  Highly recommend this tour so you get to know the palace better.
author: Winnie_C

title: Cultural insights
text: It was our first visit to Seville and we took the combined Alcazar and Cathedral tour. Our guide Rosa was informative,paced both visits well and the time flew by. As both of these amazing Minho are crowded with visitors it was great to start at opening time. Well worth it.
author: PJCDublin

title: Great Visit
text:
Rosa our guide was great, enthusiastic and informative she showed us around at a nice pace happy to answer questions and engage with our small group. I felt we gained so much more with the benefit of a knowledgeable guide than others relying on the audio guide alone. 
Well worth the visit and certainly worth booking a guide.
author: 628AlanM628
